reason: This fix scales a soldier-level collision margin (SoldierEnemyContact's per-pair contact radius, widened by a few world units per formation_mode) rather than changing anything player-controlled -- it's a physics-tuning change to how deep opposing melee lines intermix, verified directly against SoldierEnemyContact.accumulate/Unit.formation_containment_margin in test/unit/test_soldier_enemy_contact.gd and test/unit/test_unit.gd. A convincing recorded clip needs a carefully staged multi-regiment clash plus tick-by-tick state-dump verification (this repo's own convention for collision/maneuver changes) to show the difference reliably rather than misleadingly -- left as a follow-up rather than blocking this fix.
